name: smwsprites-boost-platform
title: Boost Platform
description:
Jumps up when Mario steps off the platform. Can be stood on in midair and jumped off of again.

6 cfg files are included:
- boost_plat_2tiles.cfg
- boost_plat_3tiles.cfg
- boost_plat_4tiles.cfg
^ Can only jump from their starting position.

- boost_plat_2tiles_gold.cfg
- boost_plat_3tiles_gold.cfg
- boost_plat_4tiles_gold.cfg
^ Jump off whenever Mario steps off, even when in the air.

Now PIXI compatible.
